customManagers.description: Pick up the Ansible tool pins, ansible-core and ansible-lint, in functional-tests.yml's sanity_checks job. Renovate has no manager for a uv command line in a workflow, so without this the pins would never move. They are pinned so that a new release arrives as its own pull request, which says what changed: unpinned, ansible-core 2.22.0's new no_log output masking broke the Kerbside wiring test on every pull request (#4773), and had to be held below 2.22 (#4774) until the role fix, kerbside#689, was released in shakenfist.kerbside 0.9.0. customManagers is mergeable, so this entry adds to the one the fleet preset's customManagers:githubActionsVersions contributes rather than replacing it. Kerbside pins the same two tools the same way, for the same collection (kerbside#690).

packageRules.description: Group grpcio updates together. grpcio and protobuf are coupled (each grpcio release pins a protobuf range), so major and minor updates must land in a single PR or neither can pass dependency resolution

Group oslo updates together. The OpenStack oslo libraries are released in lockstep and share internal interfaces, so they must update together. The pattern matches the family rather than listing today's members, so a fifth oslo library arriving as a transitive pin is grouped without anyone having to notice
